verdict.rationale: The SDK documents built-in guardrails that check and validate both user input and agent output. Guardrails are a configurable agent runtime behavior and appear in traces. The evidence does not show that guardrails can block a run or transform content, so only the validation part of the story is documented. missing for 10: documented blocking/tripwire behavior that halts unsafe content, documented content transformation, in-depth guardrail API docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach input/output guardrails that validate, transform, or block unsafe content

citations.quote: Guardrails enable you to do checks and validations of user input and agent output.
An agent is a large language model (LLM) configured with instructions, tools, and optional runtime behavior such as handoffs, guardrails, and structured outputs.
collecting a comprehensive record of events during an agent run: LLM generations, tool calls, handoffs, guardrails, and even custom events that occur.
